basic_profile.bio: I'm a 20-year-old university student from Cagayan de Oro, Philippines. I love exploring my identity and engaging with LGBTQ+ issues, which led me to frequently visit subreddits like 'cagayandeoro' and 'queerception'. I have a strong interest in politics and often keep up with current events on 'Senate'. I'm also fascinated by snakes and enjoy learning more about them. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after my classes. Currently single, I spend my free time volunteering at local community events or hanging out with friends at coffee shops.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a general educational background from my ongoing university studies. I’m particularly informed about local and international politics, thanks to my political science classes and a penchant for reading news articles. My interest in LGBTQ+ topics comes from personal experience and active participation in community discussions both online and offline.
